name: changers-platform
description: Changers is a cross-platform changemaker social network spanning web, desktop, and mobile.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix mobile && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c green,blue "npm --prefix web run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run web:build && npm run desktop:dist
